items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Mrs. Malone -- I think she's a tremendous person -- she'd come up to Webster Groves and sit and talk to the kids, you know. Well, Sims I met around that time.

ctx.x: E. Simms Campbell. I thought he was tremendous.
And there was a lady by the name of Mrs. Malone, Mrs. Anne Malone. She had been old college (sounds like) at that time to take up the slack when kids couldn't go to school in Jeff City,
